title: Al-Insan 76:17-21 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 43 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Insan 76:17-21 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 43. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا (١٧) عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا (١٨) ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا (١٩) وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا (٢٠) عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا (٢١)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
[From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

How to read it
rows: Qalqalah on ب (sakin); qalqalah on ق at a stop

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Insan 76:17-21 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 76:17-21 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 76:17-21 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find every qalqalah letter with sukoon in 76:17 to 21.
questions.a: The ب of «إِسْتَبْرَقٌ»; the ق at a stop on it.

questions.q: 76:20 says 'a great kingdom'. What does it teach about this world's kingdoms?
questions.a: They are small and temporary compared with Paradise.

questions.q: What is the spring in 76:18 called?
questions.a: A) Salsabil. 76:18: 'a fountain within it named Salsabil.'

questions.q: Al-Insan 76:19: «وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: The Qur'an describes Paradise with things we know (gardens, drinks, silver) but far better. Why might Allah describe it this way?
questions.a: So we can imagine it and long for it, while knowing the reality is beyond anything in this world.
